'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Rory Diabler DS Prepared Defenses''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rory Diabler]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Rory Dibeler
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
